name: Ashburton District Council
story: Terralink’s 4 March 2004 announcement names Ashburton District Council as a participant in the shared South Island orthophoto acquisition. The release describes regional imagery for local-government GIS, consent processing, land-use work, civil defence and asset management. This evidence establishes participation in the shared imagery project; it does not identify the council’s internal GIS platform or named practitioners.

sources.label: Terralink International, ‘Terralink starts biggest ever aerial photography task’, 4 March 2004
